purpose: Stable cross-subject identity and domain contract for learning, research and future AI capabilities.

rules: Canonical IDs are explicit and immutable after creation.
Canonical IDs MUST NOT be derived from display titles, array positions, current timestamps or random values.
Legacy local IDs remain unchanged in source datasets and are mapped additively to canonical IDs.
namespace identifies a stable domain or subject boundary, not a UI route.
localId is a stable author-assigned identifier and is never silently slugified.

legacyMappingContract.principle: A legacy ID alone is not a safe identity because existing datasets contain repeated local IDs, including duplicates inside one file. Every legacy mapping must carry a stable source locator or scope.

source.purpose: External or repository source from which knowledge or artifacts originate.

knowledge.purpose: A concept, principle, definition, method, formula or other knowledge object independent from presentation.

competency.purpose: A durable capability statement that can be supported by evidence.

task.purpose: A learner or researcher action request. Task definition is separate from evidence and mastery.

evidence.purpose: An immutable observation or result produced by a real action. Evidence does not directly set mastery.

artifact.purpose: A durable output such as note, code, report, dataset, figure, recording or submission with lineage.

research.purpose: A future-ready research object used from literature review through dissertation without implementing the full Research OS in L9.

provenanceContract.unknownSourcePolicy: Do not invent provenance. Leave provenance empty until a source is known.

referenceContract.danglingRefsPolicy: Allowed only during staged import; integration gates must resolve required references before promotion.

evidenceContract.principle: Tasks request actions; evidence records observations; competency/mastery engines interpret evidence later.

artifactContract.principle: Artifacts keep derivation lineage so future research, reproducibility and dissertation workflows do not need a second storage model.

extensionsContract.principle: New capabilities extend entities through namespaced extensions instead of changing stable identity.

rules: A migration never mutates its input object.
id, entityType and namespace remain unchanged across migrations.
Every migration declares explicit fromVersion and toVersion.
Legacy identity preservation requires both legacyId and legacyLocator.
Legacy payload may be preserved under extensions.legacy when needed.
No migration may use Math.random, current time or display labels to create canonical identity.

aiContract.principle: AI consumes domain objects and may suggest or draft, but does not own canonical learner truth, mastery or research conclusions.

interoperability.principle: External standards map through adapters; the core domain model does not depend on one vendor or standard.
